definition: to show something to an audience
description: In a bright clinic a physiotherapist holds up a model of the human spine and shows it to a young man in a grey T-shirt, moving her finger along the vertebrae. She then points at his lower back, has him raise his arms and stretch, and he turns to the camera smiling.

en.question: What is the woman showing the man?

phrases: beide Arme über den Kopf strecken
de.question: Was zeigt die Frau dem Mann?

es.answer: Le está enseñando un modelo de columna vertebral.
phrases: girar un modelo de columna vertebral
presionarle la parte baja de la espalda
estirar los dos brazos por encima de la cabeza
es.question: ¿Qué le está enseñando la mujer al hombre?

fr.answer: Elle lui montre un modèle de colonne vertébrale.
phrases: faire pivoter un modèle de colonne vertébrale
appuyer sur le bas de son dos
tendre les deux bras au-dessus de sa tête
